remarks: Welcome home to this beautifully maintained 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath co-op townhouse offering comfort, charm, and modern updates throughout. Freshly painted with a remodeled lower level and newly added half bath, this home blends practicality with a warm, inviting feel.  The main level features a bright living area that flows into an eat-in kitchen - perfect for family dinners or weekend gatherings. Upstairs, you'll find two spacious bedrooms with ample closet space and a full bath. The partially finished lower level adds living space ideal for a playroom, office, or cozy den.  Nestled in a peaceful community setting, this home offers convenience, comfort, and a family-friendly atmosphere - all just minutes from shops, schools, and downtown Stamford.     Listed at $320,000 - a wonderful opportunity to own in one of Stamford's most welcoming neighborhoods!  If you have concerns about financing, feel free to reach out to me directly as we can get you into this complex with as low as 5 percent down depending on your particular situation.
